"""Dokku PaaS platform manifest.

Dokku is a Docker-powered, self-hosted mini-Heroku PaaS that runs on a single
Linux server. Developers push code via `git push` over SSH; Dokku auto-detects
the language via Heroku Buildpacks (or a Dockerfile / Nixpacks / Railpack),
builds a container image, and routes HTTP(S) traffic through Nginx.

Architecture reference: https://dokku.com/docs/development/architecture/
Source: https://github.com/dokku/dokku
"""

from scryr.manifest import Diagram, Link, Manifest
from scryr.saas import Classification
from scryr.types import (
    AuthType,
    CICDToolType,
    DeploymentTarget,
    IaCToolType,
    LogAggregationType,
    MonitoringType,
    ProgrammingLanguage,
    TracingType,
    Url,
    WebFramework,
    parse_version,
)

_SOURCE = Url("https://github.com/dokku/dokku")
_DOCS = Url("https://dokku.com/docs/")
_DEPLOYMENT = DeploymentTarget.bare_metal
_CICD = CICDToolType.github_actions
_IAC = IaCToolType.none
_MONITOR = MonitoringType.none
_LOGS = LogAggregationType.none
_TRACING = TracingType.none
dokku_core_block = Manifest(
    name="Dokku Core",
    icon="🚀",
    classification=Classification.cli,
    tags=["paas", "cli", "core"],
    connections=["SSH Gateway", "Git Server", "Docker Scheduler", "Nginx Proxy"],
    description="Central PaaS engine (Go + Shell, v0.37.7). Provides the `dokku` CLI, the plugin trigger dispatcher, app lifecycle management (create / deploy / scale / destroy / run), environment config, and the admin HTTP API used by CI integrations and the Dokku Pro dashboard.",
    version=parse_version("0.37.7"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.go,
    frameworks=[WebFramework.chi],
    deployment=_DEPLOYMENT,
    owner_team="Platform",
    auth_type=AuthType.api_key,
    monitoring=_MONITOR,
    log_aggregation=_LOGS,
    tracing=_TRACING,
    iac_tool=_IAC,
    max_replicas=1,
    min_replicas=1,
    links=[
        Link(site_name="Dokku Docs", http_url=_DOCS),
        Link(site_name="Source", http_url=_SOURCE),
    ],
    repo_url=_SOURCE,
    cicd_tool=_CICD,
)
ssh_gateway_block = Manifest(
    name="SSH Gateway",
    icon="🔑",
    classification=Classification.network_gateway,
    tags=["ssh", "auth", "access-control"],
    connections=["Git Server"],
    description="SSH server layer built on `sshcommand`. Authenticates incoming connections using stored public keys (`dokku ssh-keys:add`), then translates the git push command into a dokku deploy trigger — without granting shell access to the server.",
    version=parse_version("0.37.7"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.bash,
    deployment=_DEPLOYMENT,
    owner_team="Platform",
    auth_type=AuthType.api_key,
    monitoring=_MONITOR,
    log_aggregation=_LOGS,
    tracing=_TRACING,
    iac_tool=_IAC,
    max_replicas=1,
    min_replicas=1,
    links=[
        Link(
            site_name="User Mgmt Docs",
            http_url=Url("https://dokku.com/docs/deployment/user-management/"),
        )
    ],
    repo_url=_SOURCE,
    cicd_tool=_CICD,
)
git_server_block = Manifest(
    name="Git Server",
    icon="📦",
    classification=Classification.internal_api,
    tags=["git", "vcs", "deploy-trigger"],
    connections=["App Builder"],
    description="Bare git repository manager (Go plugin). Maintains one bare repo per app under `/var/lib/dokku/`. On `git push`, the post-receive hook fires and passes the source archive to the build pipeline.",
    version=parse_version("0.37.7"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.go,
    deployment=_DEPLOYMENT,
    owner_team="Platform",
    auth_type=AuthType.api_key,
    monitoring=_MONITOR,
    log_aggregation=_LOGS,
    tracing=_TRACING,
    iac_tool=_IAC,
    max_replicas=1,
    min_replicas=1,
    links=[
        Link(
            site_name="Git Deploy Docs",
            http_url=Url("https://dokku.com/docs/deployment/methods/git/"),
        )
    ],
    repo_url=_SOURCE,
    cicd_tool=_CICD,
)
app_builder_block = Manifest(
    name="App Builder",
    icon="🔨",
    classification=Classification.job_processor,
    tags=["buildpack", "docker", "image-build"],
    connections=["Docker Scheduler"],
    description="Pluggable build subsystem. Default builder is Herokuish — auto-detects language via official Heroku Buildpacks and compiles a Docker image. Alternatives include Dockerfile, Cloud Native Buildpacks (pack), Nixpacks, and Railpack. Outputs a tagged Docker image pushed to the local daemon.",
    version=parse_version("0.37.7"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.go,
    deployment=_DEPLOYMENT,
    owner_team="Platform",
    auth_type=AuthType.none,
    monitoring=_MONITOR,
    log_aggregation=_LOGS,
    tracing=_TRACING,
    iac_tool=_IAC,
    max_replicas=1,
    min_replicas=1,
    links=[
        Link(
            site_name="Builders Docs",
            http_url=Url("https://dokku.com/docs/deployment/builders/builder-management/"),
        ),
        Link(site_name="Herokuish", http_url=Url("https://github.com/gliderlabs/herokuish")),
    ],
    repo_url=_SOURCE,
    cicd_tool=_CICD,
)
docker_scheduler_block = Manifest(
    name="Docker Scheduler",
    icon="🐳",
    classification=Classification.scheduler,
    tags=["scheduler", "containers", "runtime"],
    connections=["Nginx Proxy"],
    description="Default container scheduler (`scheduler-docker-local`). Runs app processes defined in `Procfile` as Docker containers on the local daemon, enforces resource limits, performs zero-downtime deploy checks, and manages persistent storage mounts.",
    version=parse_version("0.37.7"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.go,
    deployment=_DEPLOYMENT,
    owner_team="Platform",
    auth_type=AuthType.none,
    monitoring=_MONITOR,
    log_aggregation=_LOGS,
    tracing=_TRACING,
    iac_tool=_IAC,
    max_replicas=1,
    min_replicas=1,
    links=[
        Link(
            site_name="Scheduler Docs",
            http_url=Url("https://dokku.com/docs/deployment/schedulers/docker-local/"),
        )
    ],
    repo_url=_SOURCE,
    cicd_tool=_CICD,
)
cron_scheduler_block = Manifest(
    name="Cron Scheduler",
    icon="⏰",
    classification=Classification.scheduler,
    tags=["cron", "tasks", "scheduler"],
    connections=["Docker Scheduler"],
    description="Manages scheduled one-off tasks declared in `app.json` (cron section). Writes systemd crontab entries per app and fires `dokku run` containers on schedule, with full log capture.",
    version=parse_version("0.37.7"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.go,
    deployment=_DEPLOYMENT,
    owner_team="Platform",
    auth_type=AuthType.none,
    monitoring=_MONITOR,
    log_aggregation=_LOGS,
    tracing=_TRACING,
    iac_tool=_IAC,
    max_replicas=1,
    min_replicas=1,
    links=[
        Link(
            site_name="Cron Docs",
            http_url=Url("https://dokku.com/docs/processes/scheduled-cron-tasks/"),
        )
    ],
    repo_url=_SOURCE,
    cicd_tool=_CICD,
)
nginx_proxy_block = Manifest(
    name="Nginx Proxy",
    icon="⚙️",
    classification=Classification.network_gateway,
    tags=["proxy", "routing", "tls"],
    connections=[],
    description="Default HTTP/HTTPS reverse proxy (`nginx-vhosts` plugin). Renders per-app nginx vhost configs on every deploy, routes `$APP.domain.tld` to the running container port, upgrades WebSocket connections, and terminates TLS. Caddy, Traefik, HAProxy, and OpenResty are plug-in alternatives.",
    version=parse_version("1.27.0"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.c,
    deployment=_DEPLOYMENT,
    owner_team="Platform",
    auth_type=AuthType.none,
    monitoring=_MONITOR,
    log_aggregation=_LOGS,
    tracing=_TRACING,
    iac_tool=_IAC,
    max_replicas=1,
    min_replicas=1,
    links=[
        Link(
            site_name="Proxy Docs", http_url=Url("https://dokku.com/docs/networking/proxies/nginx/")
        )
    ],
    repo_url=_SOURCE,
    cicd_tool=_CICD,
)
certs_plugin_block = Manifest(
    name="Certs Plugin",
    icon="🔒",
    classification=Classification.worker,
    tags=["tls", "certs", "security"],
    connections=["Nginx Proxy"],
    description="TLS certificate manager. Stores and applies per-app or wildcard certs (`dokku certs:add`). Integrates with the community `dokku-letsencrypt` plugin for automatic ACME certificate issuance and renewal via the Nginx HTTP-01 challenge.",
    version=parse_version("0.37.7"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.go,
    deployment=_DEPLOYMENT,
    owner_team="Platform",
    auth_type=AuthType.none,
    monitoring=_MONITOR,
    log_aggregation=_LOGS,
    tracing=_TRACING,
    iac_tool=_IAC,
    max_replicas=1,
    min_replicas=1,
    links=[Link(site_name="SSL Docs", http_url=Url("https://dokku.com/docs/configuration/ssl/"))],
    repo_url=_SOURCE,
    cicd_tool=_CICD,
)
plugin_system_block = Manifest(
    name="Plugin System",
    icon="🧩",
    classification=Classification.sdk,
    tags=["plugins", "extensibility", "hooks"],
    connections=["Dokku Core"],
    description="Bash-based plugin trigger and lifecycle system. Installs community plugins from git URLs (`dokku plugin:install`), manages plugin updates, and dispatches named trigger hooks (50+ built-in triggers) to all registered plugins in priority order, enabling the full plugin ecosystem.",
    version=parse_version("0.37.7"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.bash,
    deployment=_DEPLOYMENT,
    owner_team="Platform",
    auth_type=AuthType.none,
    monitoring=_MONITOR,
    log_aggregation=_LOGS,
    tracing=_TRACING,
    iac_tool=_IAC,
    max_replicas=1,
    min_replicas=1,
    links=[
        Link(
            site_name="Plugin Docs",
            http_url=Url("https://dokku.com/docs/advanced-usage/plugin-management/"),
        ),
        Link(
            site_name="Plugin Triggers",
            http_url=Url("https://dokku.com/docs/development/plugin-triggers/"),
        ),
    ],
    repo_url=_SOURCE,
    cicd_tool=_CICD,
)

dokku_diagram = Diagram(
    name="Dokku",
    manifests=[
        dokku_core_block,
        ssh_gateway_block,
        git_server_block,
        app_builder_block,
        docker_scheduler_block,
        cron_scheduler_block,
        nginx_proxy_block,
        certs_plugin_block,
        plugin_system_block,
    ],
)

info.description: Pluggable build subsystem. Default builder is Herokuish — auto-detects language via official Heroku Buildpacks and compiles a Docker image. Alternatives include Dockerfile, Cloud Native Buildpacks (pack), Nixpacks, and Railpack. Outputs a tagged Docker image pushed to the local daemon.

TLS certificate manager. Stores and applies per-app or wildcard certs (`dokku certs:add`). Integrates with the community `dokku-letsencrypt` plugin for automatic ACME certificate issuance and renewal via the Nginx HTTP-01 challenge.
Manages scheduled one-off tasks declared in `app.json` (cron section). Writes systemd crontab entries per app and fires `dokku run` containers on schedule, with full log capture.

Default container scheduler (`scheduler-docker-local`). Runs app processes defined in `Procfile` as Docker containers on the local daemon, enforces resource limits, performs zero-downtime deploy checks, and manages persistent storage mounts.

Central PaaS engine (Go + Shell, v0.37.7). Provides the `dokku` CLI, the plugin trigger dispatcher, app lifecycle management (create / deploy / scale / destroy / run), environment config, and the admin HTTP API used by CI integrations and the Dokku Pro dashboard.
Bare git repository manager (Go plugin). Maintains one bare repo per app under `/var/lib/dokku/`. On `git push`, the post-receive hook fires and passes the source archive to the build pipeline.

Default HTTP/HTTPS reverse proxy (`nginx-vhosts` plugin). Renders per-app nginx vhost configs on every deploy, routes `$APP.domain.tld` to the running container port, upgrades WebSocket connections, and terminates TLS. Caddy, Traefik, HAProxy, and OpenResty are plug-in alternatives.

Bash-based plugin trigger and lifecycle system. Installs community plugins from git URLs (`dokku plugin:install`), manages plugin updates, and dispatches named trigger hooks (50+ built-in triggers) to all registered plugins in priority order, enabling the full plugin ecosystem.
